findings: non-blocking: reckon/crew/promotion.py:291 _retire_review_pointer unlinks whatever pointer is live for the run unless the unlink itself raises OSError, without the attempt comparison that both other pointer removals apply (promotion.py:223-251 _remove_promoted_pointer compares attempt, attempt_kind, phase, pid and pid_start_time; reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:196-206 _release_marked_pointer compares pointer_attempt against the attempt the mark names). The path is entered precisely when the pointer moved, and a moved pointer can be a newer attempt written by a resume, so a promotion that finishes after a reviewer is resumed deletes that live attempt's pointer and leaves the resumed worker with nothing to complete with.

non-blocking: reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:460 retire_stuck_review_pointers retires the live pointer but never calls clear_pending, so a review run promoted with --land leaves its pending-dir record (written at reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3653) behind; the same finish_pending_landings pass then reads that record in the loop below at pending_landing.py:470 onward, finds the ledger row present and no live pointer, and either re-attempts a landing at the review's cited head or leaves the record on disk indefinitely, while the no-live-pointer branch at pending_landing.py:545 no longer short-circuits it.
